g.title: crate Independent node, event, scene, measurement and motion protocol.
crate::drawing Resolved canvas geometry and layers; no backend types cross the wire.
crate::events Shared input values and events from the engine to the client.
crate::host Environment values at start and the result of a client turn.
crate::id_hash Provides cheaply hashed maps keyed by node identifiers.
crate::ids Identifiers shared by the core and the engine: nodes, requests and revisions.
crate::paint Paint and fill protocol types.
crate::scene Draw scenes (canvas and per-node draw layers) and hit/semantics regions.
crate::semantics Accessibility semantics carried by nodes and scene regions.
crate::values Defines scalar layout, color and alignment values.
